Container.Name: StreamPilot
Container.Overview:
StreamPilot — a self-hosted management and analytics portal for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby. User onboarding, access expiry, Discover & Request, analytics, ColleXions, Poster Sets, Overlays, Scanner, and Native Media Automation.
After install, open the WebUI and sign in with your media-server admin account, then finish setup in Settings.
Optional ColleXions: enable in Settings → ColleXions (worker is bundled in this image — no second container). Data is stored under the Config Directory at collexions/.
Native Media Automation (System tab / Intel iGPU util): change Repository to ghcr.io/jl94x4/streampilot:nightly and Force Update (Restart alone keeps the old image). Stock template :latest does not include Media Automation nightly fixes or intel_gpu_top.
Map media library paths below so the container can see the same files as Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr (container paths must match ARR paths, or use Scanner/Media Automation rewrites). CPU mode needs no GPU.
Intel/AMD GPU: set Host Path for "GPU Devices (Intel/AMD)" to /dev/dri. Live Intel util also needs host perf access (sysctl kernel.perf_event_paranoid=0 or ≤2). NVIDIA GPU: install the Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin, set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to your GPU UUID (or all), keep NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all, and add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (Advanced View). Do not enable Privileged.
Tags: :latest (main), :beta, :nightly, or pin e.g. :1.8.0.
Image: ghcr.io/jl94x4/streampilot (legacy alias ghcr.io/jl94x4/server-manager-portal still receives the same tags).
The container entrypoint automatically fixes appdata folder permissions on startup. Existing installs using /mnt/user/appdata/server-manager-portal/ can keep that path.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Portal web interface port.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Persistent JSON data (users, settings, caches, logs). Container path: /app/config. Existing installs may keep /mnt/user/appdata/server-manager-portal/config.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Rolling backup snapshots created from Settings. Container path: /app/backup. Existing installs may keep /mnt/user/appdata/server-manager-portal/backup.

Config.Name: Media Root
Config.Description: Optional catch-all media root for Native Media Automation. Host example: /mnt/user/media. Leave empty when unused. Prefer the specific library paths below when your ARR apps use separate roots.

Config.Name: TV Shows
Config.Description: Optional TV library path for Media Automation / Scanner. Host example: /mnt/user/media/tv. Container path must match Sonarr (or use a rewrite).

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Optional movie library path for Media Automation / Scanner. Host example: /mnt/user/media/movies. Container path must match Radarr (or use a rewrite).

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Optional music library path for Media Automation / Scanner. Host example: /mnt/user/media/music. Container path must match Lidarr (or use a rewrite).

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Optional downloads / incomplete path if Media Automation or ARR workflows need it inside the portal container. Host example: /mnt/user/downloads.

Config.Name: Completed / Output
Config.Description: Optional Media Automation copy/output destination (Unmanic-style Completed). Host example: /mnt/user/automation/completed. Use container path /completed in library Output path.

Config.Name: Quarantine
Config.Description: Optional Media Automation quarantine folder before replace. Host example: /mnt/user/automation/quarantine. Use container path /quarantine in library Quarantine path.

Config.Name: Media Library Extra 1
Config.Description: Optional extra media root. Set Host Path and change Container Path to match your library layout. Use Unraid Add another Path for more roots.

Config.Name: Media Library Extra 2
Config.Description: Optional extra media root. Set Host Path and change Container Path to match your library layout.

Config.Name: GPU Devices (Intel/AMD)
Config.Description: Intel QSV / Intel VAAPI / AMD VAAPI. Set BOTH Host and Container to /dev/dri when using an Intel or AMD GPU. Leave blank for CPU-only or NVIDIA-only. The image entrypoint attaches the /dev/dri device GIDs after dropping to PUID:PGID so render nodes stay usable.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: NVIDIA NVENC. Install Unraid Nvidia Driver plugin first. Set to your GPU UUID from the plugin page (recommended) or all. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (Advanced View). Leave empty for CPU-only / Intel / AMD.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: Used with NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Unraid Nvidia Driver docs recommend all. Also required: Advanced View → Extra Parameters must include --runtime=nvidia (example: --restart=unless-stopped --hostname=streampilot --runtime=nvidia). Leave NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty when not using NVIDIA.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the application as (default 99 on Unraid).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the application as (default 100 on Unraid).

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: Required session signing secret (minimum 32 characters). Generate a secure random string to use here.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Optional bootstrap HTTPS URL (no trailing slash). Prefer Settings → Portal UI → Public Base URL after first login. For subpath hosting include the path, e.g. https://plex.example.com/portal

Config.Name: Base Path
Config.Description: Optional URL prefix when hosted under a subpath (e.g. /portal). Leave empty for root hosting.

Config.Name: Force Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to true only when the portal is served over HTTPS. Must be false for plain HTTP LAN access (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:2121).

Config.Name: Allow Private Integration URLs
Config.Description: Allow Sonarr/Radarr/Tautulli URLs on LAN/private IPs (recommended for homelab).

Config.Name: Plex Remote Connection
Config.Description: Use LAN/remote Plex URL instead of localhost when running in Docker. Auto-detected if unset; set true for Unraid.

Config.Name: Setup Token
Config.Description: Optional one-time token for remote first-time setup.

Config.Name: Plex OAuth Client ID
Config.Description: Optional fixed Plex OAuth client id (auto-generated on first run if empty).

Config.Name: Config Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal runtime data path (normally leave as /app/config).

Config.Name: Media Automation Config Path
Config.Description: Internal Media Automation state path under the persistent config mount.

Config.Name: Media Automation Work Path
Config.Description: Internal Media Automation work metadata path under the persistent config mount.

Config.Name: Bind Host
Config.Description: Network interface to bind.

Config.Name: Internal Port
Config.Description: Application listen port inside the container.
